reviews.author: L.D
reviews.text: I ordered the laksa-flavoured ramen, a dish with a distinctive lemongrass aroma that tends to divide opinion. It’s a love-it-or-hate-it flavour: those who enjoy it will keep coming back for more, while those who dislike it are unlikely to order it again. My bowl of noodles was cooked to perfection. Maki & Ramen is located on the lower ground floor of St James Quarter. The restaurant is characterised by its entrance drum, artificial cherry blossoms, and walls covered with cartoon drawings and handwritten notes. Whenever a customer arrives, the staff beat the drum to announce their arrival, letting everyone know that new business has just walked through the door. The cartoon drawings and messages on the walls are entertaining and make the waiting time more enjoyable. We arrived in the evening, and the indoor dining area was already full. Despite how busy the restaurant was, we didn't have to wait long for our food. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and efficient, making the whole dining experience very pleasant.

reviews.author: Phoebe Chen
reviews.text: The servers are friendly enough and I can see they aren’t slacking at all, but management is clearly a little disorganised beginning from when you are sat down to the order and timing of the food being brought out. We ordered 2 ramens (tonkostu ramen & steak ramen) and 1 green dragon roll which came to £55. Not much to complain about the sushi it was quite nice, but the ramen is another story. The broth was thick, heavy and oily which is basically the complete opposite of what good ramen is meant to be (light & clean). There was something off with the noodles it seemed to have a weird texture and was chewy. Perhaps it was boiled for too long? Needless to say, we didn’t finish the ramen at all and still spent £55. In the photo attached you can see the layer of oil. Maybe this restaurant is more suited to British tastes, very clearly not targeted for actual Asian palettes.

reviews.author: Jamie Louise
reviews.text: As always the food was brilliant! Highly recommend the black garlic tonkatsu! Unfortunately the floor and the stairs were so slippery it was like an ice rink. It was a massive health and safety hazard. I almost fell several times coming down from the bathrooms despite clinging to the hand rails. It was like there was a layer of oil across the floor that got worse the closer you go to the kitchen or upstairs. The toilets were also in desperate need of a good deep clean, limescale removal and the floor scrubbing as it was dirty. Was suprised it got a 5* hygiene rating so recently with these issues. Hope they're fixed quickly as I love to eat here and would really worry about going back and falling. Unfortunately the staff seemed stressed, but I would be too trying to not spill food and drinks on a floor that slippery. I hope the management invest in a deep clean to fix the oily issues and the bathrooms.

reviews.author: Cee
reviews.text: We visited Maki & Ramen in meadowhall at around 1 pm on 25 October 2026, and I wanted to leave a special mention for a young blonde waitress wearing a kimono. Unfortunately, I didn’t get her name, but I really hope management knows who she is and recognises what a fantastic job she was doing. She was absolutely lovely! Despite what was clearly a stressful situation, she remained, polite, friendly and welcoming throughout. She had such a lovely, happy face and a genuinely warm attitude, even when things were obviously difficult. Her hard work and work ethic really stood out to us, and I hope she knows that these qualities will take her far in life. Please keep it up! However, I do feel it is important to highlight the staffing situation. There appeared to be only three waiting staff while all the tables were full, which simply didn’t seem enough to manage the restaurant effectively. We had to get the waitress’s attention to place our order, and we witnessed another table complaining and speaking quite rudely to her, despite the lack of staff clearly not being her fault. It was a shame to see someone who was trying so hard to do her job being put in that position. The staff deserve enough support to be able to do their jobs properly, especially during busy periods. Our previous experience at this branch wasn’t particularly great, as we were served by someone who was quite rude, which had put us off returning a little. However, this visit has completely changed that impression, and we will definitely be coming back! A huge well done to her — she was a real credit to the restaurant.

reviews.author: Luca Cabrini
reviews.text: I ordered the "spicy seafood ramen." I knew it would be spicy, but I certainly did not expect the noodles to taste like supermarket instant noodles rather than fresh ones. The salmon was dry, and the other piece of fish was chewy and rubbery and dish itself smell like old food. Even though I left my dish almost untouched, no one from the staff checked on us or asked if everything was okay. On top of that, the staff were extremely loud. While we were still eating, they started emptying bins and left bags of rubbish behind our table because they were getting ready to close. It was very noisy and showed little consideration for customers who were still dining. This was my fourth visit. The first two times were shortly after they opened, and I have to say the quality has dropped significantly since then. When it was time to pay, the manager asked if I wanted to take the food home. After I explained that I hadn't enjoyed the meal, her only response was, "Oh, okay, sorry," before walking away. Honestly, I wasn't expecting a discount or for the dish to be removed from the bill. I simply expected a bit more care and attention towards the customer. I truly believe this will be my last visit here (even though you'll probably think, "Okay, no problem"). It's disappointing to see how much things have changed.

We ordered the tonkatsu ramen with black garlic, prawn panko sushi, salmon avocado sushi, sashimi, chicken karaage, pumpkin croquettes and kids bento box and it was all fantastic. The Geisha cocktail was ok but a bit sickly sweet with syrup. Would recommend they expand their cocktail offering with less syrup based options. Nonetheless a lovely meal. Thank you and we will be back again!

reviews.author: Maria Itiacandy
reviews.text: The drinks were the highlight... The food was fine except for the dessert which I sent back and which was taken off the menu. The chocolate matcha brownie came with vanilla ice cream that was not defrosted or melted properly/ ready to be served to customers. The chocolate sauce/syrup was awful it tasted like the squeezy chocolate sauce you get in the supermarkets. The brownie itself had a strange texture that was neither gooey, dense, OR traditionally cakey for a brownie. The texture was on the tougher side. The flavour tasted like stolen/ christmas cake... Something was clearly wrong here. The server tried to allude to my racial background and say maybe that's why I didn't enjoy the desert... And maybe I'm not used to the matcha taste...which was inappropriate and I corrected her promptly. I like matcha but this dessert was awful. You can (try) see in the picture how pale the brownie looks....

reviews.author: K B
reviews.text: Whoever runs this restaurant should be ashame! First of all, this is my second bad time, the first time was also bad but the food is good so i decided to bring my friends, so we went in again, but no one welcome us, had to find our own dirty table, then the menu took 10 minutes to arrive, but the server was good he kept apologising. Then the food took another 30 minutes to arrive, this time it was so overcook the squid actually became so chewy we didn’t even finish it. Then the drinks, another 10 more minutes or so, my was so sweet and can’t taste any alcohol at all. So in the end the server gave us free drinks, but i still think we should be happy and satisfy with our service. And we are not! I have many restaurants myself and this is not the right way to run a business. So my conclusion, seeing the servers running on but ignoring customers is a pity, the restaurant owner should hire more staff, they have only three but it’s a big restaurant, and the servers is also the bartender? Where is your standard ? This is how u get bankrupt! If i can give zero star i would give to who ever own the restaurant, but the extra star is for the servers because they are only doing there job. So how do u plan to compensate my appalling experience?

reviews.author: Shaz R.
reviews.text: I really don’t want this to come across as complaining, as I understand that not everything was within Maki Ramen’s control, especially as I ordered through Slerp. However, the back and forth between Slerp and Maki Ramen while trying to cancel the order was exhausting, particularly after being told I couldn’t cancel. We’ve just moved in and currently don’t have a kitchen or microwave, so waiting over an hour only to receive cold food was really upsetting, especially as I was starving. In the end, we couldn’t even eat the food, which was really disappointing given the circumstances. I appreciated receiving a full refund, and I was also grateful that a goodwill gesture was offered for the inconvenience by Chris the assistant manager, although I haven’t received any further update on this. I’m not trying to be difficult or unappreciative, and I do understand that things can go wrong. I was just really disappointed because, after such a stressful move and currently not having a kitchen or microwave, the experience was much harder than it needed to be. Ultimately, we were left unable to eat our food after waiting over an hour, and although the refund was appreciated, it didn’t change how disappointing the overall experience was.

reviews.author: Massimiliano Vitali
reviews.text: Looking at all the positive reviews, I don't understand whether they are all fake or whether I was just unlucky. We entered the restaurant without a reservation, and the manager didn't seem very happy to welcome us. No one pointed out that there were specials on a board on the wall. We had to ask twice for our drinks because they never arrived, and three times for tap water. No one asked us about allergies when taking our order. The food was well presented but of fairly average quality. Nothing I ordered really stood out. There was no salmon available, and the only dessert was unavailable too. I didn't have a great experience.
